manifest.method: token_delta = tokens(ainglish) - tokens(english) for each semantic minimal pair; mean six independently authored pairs per tokenizer; report the worst (least-saving) tokenizer mean. Reproduce with ainglish 0.2.16 and tiktoken 0.13.0 using cl100k_base and o200k_base.
